summary: Test-writing run for issue #39: committed the upstream solver parity corpus (byte-identical, SHA-256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) as a test fixture, added SolverParityCorpusTests replaying all 12 scenarios through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and CompositionSolver (score tables, selection, error, tie_broke, tied_indices, exclusions), added PaletteAPIClientContractTests pinning the /api/v1 wire behavior as the migration net for the swift-openapi generated client, and documented corpus consumption/refresh in docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed here; parity expectations were validated with an independent Python replay of the scorer semantics over all 12 corpus scenarios (all pass). Implementation (swift-openapi-generator adoption, README section) belongs to the follow-up implementation run per phase rules.
